summary: OWNH covers fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners, and tens of thousands of lines. Ownership is concentrated: [O1] holds 54.4% of lines, compared with 10.6% for [O2] and 6.5% for [O3].

At [T0], principal-owner share is 54.3%, up from 51.2% at [T-3]. Inactive-owner share is 76.3%, down from 77.9% over the same period; both majorities are already established. The next blank-line milestone is projected for [T+22].

Cross-repository ownership remains uneven, and methods agree in no repositories. Removed lines equal 48.7% of added lines, with 95.6% of removals belonging to others; [O4] accounts for 30.4% of removals. Code survival has a two-year half-life, not a projection.

okr.objective: Build more balanced, current, and consistently measured code ownership across the portfolio.

keyResults.text: Reduce principal-owner concentration from its [T0] baseline of 54.3%, which has risen from 51.2% at [T-3].
Reduce inactive-owner concentration from its [T0] baseline of 76.3%; it remains a majority despite declining from 77.9% at [T-3].
Establish cross-method agreement from a baseline of no repositories where methods agree.
